items.exampleEn: Our primary goal this year is to grow sales.
items.exampleZh: 我們今年的主要目標是提高業績。

items.exampleEn: Price is the prime reason people shop online.
items.exampleZh: 價格是人們上網購物的主要原因。

items.exampleEn: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
items.exampleZh: 實際費用比我們預期的高。

items.exampleEn: Sales have increased significantly this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年的銷售量大幅增加。

items.exampleEn: This new printer in our office has multiple functions.
items.exampleZh: 我們辦公室這台新印表機有多種功能。

items.exampleEn: Customer service is at the core of our business.
items.exampleZh: 客戶服務是我們事業的核心。

items.exampleEn: This course is designed specifically for beginners.
items.exampleZh: 這個課程是專門為初學者設計的。

items.exampleEn: He studied at a technical college to become an engineer.
items.exampleZh: 他讀技術學院，想成為工程師。

items.sentenceEn: The actual meeting starts at ten, not at nine as the email said.
items.sentenceZh: 會議實際上十點開始，不是信上說的九點。

items.audioEn: I called you multiple times yesterday, but nobody answered.
items.audioZh: 我昨天打給你好幾次，但都沒人接。

items.sentenceEn: Traffic has become significantly worse since the new mall opened.
items.sentenceZh: 自從新的購物中心開幕，交通變得糟糕許多。

items.sentenceEn: I asked specifically for a room with a sea view.
items.sentenceZh: 我特地要求一間看得到海的房間。

items.stemEn: Our ____ concern is safety; everything else comes second.
items.stemZh: 我們的首要考量是安全；其他一切都是次要的。

items.stemEn: Teamwork is one of the company's ____ values.
items.stemZh: 團隊合作是公司的核心價值之一。

items.passageEn: When Daniel opened his first restaurant, he chose a prime location near the main train station. His primary goal was to serve good food at fair prices. In the first year, however, the actual number of customers was lower than he had planned. He looked at the problem from multiple angles and found the core issue: people did not know his restaurant existed. So he hired a young designer specifically to improve his website, a costly but wise decision. There were a few technical problems at first, but within six months, the number of customers had risen significantly.
items.passageZh: Daniel 開第一家餐廳時，選在主要火車站附近的黃金地段。他的首要目標是以合理的價格提供好吃的食物。然而第一年，實際的客人數比他原本規劃的少。他從多個角度檢視這個問題，找出了核心原因：大家根本不知道有他這家餐廳。於是他特地聘請一位年輕設計師來改善網站，這個決定花費不小，卻很明智。一開始出了一些技術問題，但不到六個月，客人數就大幅增加了。

questions.questionZh: Daniel 第一年遇到什麼問題？
Daniel 請年輕設計師做什麼？

items.promptZh: 這份工作需要很多專業技術知識。
referenceEn: This job requires a lot of technical knowledge.
You need a lot of technical knowledge for this job.
rubricZh: technical 放在名詞前，表示「技術上的、專業的」（例如 technical knowledge、technical skills）

items.instructionZh: 用 significantly 造一個句子，說說你生活中某件事明顯改變了。
referenceEn: My English has improved significantly since I started reading every day.
My rent has gone up significantly this year.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 significantly，修飾變化的動詞或比較級（例如 improved significantly、significantly better）
句子要說到你自己生活中的變化
